customManagers.description: Track the cosign CLI release that build.yml signs the image with and nightly-compliance.yml verifies it with. Dependabot moves the sigstore/cosign-installer SHA, but the action's cosign-release input is a plain string that neither bot reads without this manager. Both pins are in workflows, so one PR moves them together, which tests/test-nightly-compliance.sh requires.

packageRules.description: Dependabot owns GitHub Actions version updates; disable Renovate's github-actions manager to avoid duplicate PRs. Renovate still owns the Chunkah custom manager above.
Containerfile images are hand-managed via ARGs; the weekly scheduled build tracks :stable by design. Do not update or pin them.

Never automerge a cosign CLI bump. The signature it writes is what README.md's `cosign verify --key cosign.pub` and the nightly verify check, and cosign 3 changed the default signature format, so each new release needs a reviewer to confirm both still verify.
